title: Just A Little Something
body:
# Mod Download

you just do the mod stuff

# Mod Features

Crystal Dimension 🔮

Soulbound Weapons 👻

Sanity 🧠

Blood Seasons 🩸

# What Does This Mod Do?

Crystal dimension is crafted with something i forgot. It's a crystal dimension.

Soulbound weapons are crafted with soulsand and punish you if you do something wrong with the tools/sword.

Sanity decreases with light level so be careful!

Blood Seasons do nothing currently.

# ⚠️ NOTICE ⚠️

Few things to note that:

This is a VERY early stage!

This was made in MCreator, I may not update to different versions.

Bugs should be reported here: https://discord.gg/EQKYagpukx

# UPCOMING!

Please remember that spoilers exist for a reason!


<details>
<summary>2nd Update</summary>

Patches such as Sanity taking too long or short,
effects of sanity (cave noises, effects) staying even in light.

</details>

Have fun!
